label: Editing the same file again after a failing test
reason: The last test run failed, one file has now been rewritten at least three times, and there is an unverified edit on top of it: the agent is guessing rather than reading the failure.
nudge: The tests failed and you have rewritten this file three times. Stop editing: print the failing assertion and the value it saw, then make one targeted change.
citation: Ochiai feature repeated edits without a passing test on nebius/SWE-agent-trajectories.
